_doc: Blueprint model format. One stud = 1 unit in x/z, one brick height = 1 unit in y. 'bricks' are the pieces; 'steps' list which bricks exist at that build step, so students can step through the assembly in 3D. Author these from photos, from an LDraw/Studio model, or by hand.
